mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ROUTE_LIKE(ROUTE_NUM, USER_NUM, LIKE_DT) VALUES(#{routeId}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ROUTE_LIKE WHERE ROUTE_NUM = #{routeId} AND USER_NUM = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT R.ROUTE_NUM, U.NAME, U.PROFILE, R.TITLE, R.STATE, R.PARTICIPANT_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(CU.USER_NUM) FROM CHATTING_USER CU WHERE CHATTING_NUM = ( SELECT CHATTING_NUM FROM CHATTING C WHERE C.ROUTE_NUM = R.ROUTE_NUM ) ) AS CURRENT_USER_COUNT, R.PICTURE, R.CREATE_DATE, R.START_DATE, R.END_DATE, R.CONTENT FROM ROUTE R INNER JOIN ROUTE_LIKE RL ON R.ROUTE_NUM = RL.ROUTE_NUM LEFT JOIN USERS U ON R.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM WHERE RL.USER_NUM = #{userId} ORDER BY RL.LIKE_DT DESC
